notes.title: Update Version 0.2.1 "Shopkeeper"
notes.content: [p]This is a small update.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added Character: Shopkeeper[/p][/*][*][p]Added Shop System[/p][/*][*][p]Added Item Bank System[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to send fish caught from the fishing minigame to the Item Bank[/p][/*][*][p]Added Pop-up Numbers on Damage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some things (i don't remember how many)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964962/dc3438fa0a7cfd935639f71ba5aad8bbaa77aacd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964962/80eb5f75073221d1d4f5e522a96135f4380b44d9.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964962/bdaf7408390faf234d5bff99d6b5d848c5282db3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This is a pretty small update that implements the shop and item bank system. I'll be using and expanding on these systems once I work on version 0.3 but for now the base is set and functional. Later on, I'll make it so that you can upgrade your bank to store more things and the shop will upgrade on its own which will result in more things sold with higher available tiers.[/p][p][/p][p]For the numbers on hit; I just thought of adding it while I was making the shop work. I've also made it so that a number pops up when you buy or sell things. Also, when it comes to the numbers, if you notice that when it rolls a critical hit, it may be lower than your previous non critical hit with the same attack. This is because it low rolled the damage and that happened to crit. I should probably adjust it so that a critical low roll hit should at least be closer on average to a non critical high roll.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, the shopkeeper. I spent more time modeling the shopkeeper than making all the code/blueprints for this update. She is an NPC and I should probably figure a way to speed up the modeling pipeline for NPCs so when I do version 0.3 it doesn't take forever.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's mostly it. Next update; version 0.2.2 I'll be implementing Items in Combat, similarly if you've played the legend of Dragoon, the item "burn-out", something like that. Also the next character, per suggestion is the Dullahan. Her design is in the character select. Her concept is she's a fungus in the shape of a human where her main body is her head. The rest of her body is just an appendage which she uses as a weapon to spook people. She's also fire elemented so she could probably self-destruct her body. I might make that a secondary ult move or something.[/p][p][/p][p]-regalfang[/p]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964962/91797465e1ccdbabc9625a98f8d39f0d02083c8d.jpg[/img]

First of all, there is a decent amount of stuff I still want to implement for this update. It will be version 0.2.0 b and I'll probably implement it within the next 2 weeks to a month from now. This includes:

[list]
[*]Colosseum mode's Leveling Tier system
[*]Free camera mode menu
[*]Adding more visual wise to the colosseum to take advantage of UE 5.5's Lumen lighting
[/list]

I also want to expand the inventory system and the use/collecting of items but that's for a later update.

Now, I should explain some of the update. There are [b]2 COPIES[/b]  of the game now. One with ray tracing off (the default) and one with it on. The reason why is because UE doesn't allow you to turn it off and on in-game for now so this is my short solution to implement Raytracing. Honestly, there's not much difference visually since I haven't implemented any new designs to the stage yet so...

The Knight is a human character that should be able to equip weapons, but not right now. The Equipment system is not ready yet. Other Humans should be able to equip corresponding weapons to their class when I have all the systems ready.

The Team Attacks are a remedy to the long combat times of 3 v 3 fights. They are enacted when you choose the same attack for your characters with in the turn. This results in you rushing down an opponent and reducing the time of the turn by skipping all other cooperating character's turns. I'll probably add other mechanics to make the combat more better but I don't want to throw any and all ideas that could be brought up just yet.

and that's it for now. Expect another update hopefully within a month. If there's any issues or suggestions, I'd like to hear it. and hope you have a nice day. I still need to rework some of the art... and the music...

-regalfang

notes.title: Development Version 0.2.0
notes.content:
This is the first major update for the game since release and I'd like to share what I've done so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964962/cfe1599a5e2baf70d6508b6a05908468ce82b159.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44964962/599efc97bc8b24e5b456e05f4857fa8535f40582.jpg[/img]


I haven't done the next character yet, but I have done a lot of the Quality of Life stuff. After I complete the next character I'll do more slight fixes other additions before I release the update. As for the list of things I already done:

[list]
[*]Added "Team Attacks"
[*]Added Element: Water
[*]Added additional effects to Elements

[list]
[*]Fire - on turn 3, turns into "Blue Fire" doing massive damage per turn
[*]Ice - can "Shatter" when hit by an Ice or Non elemental Critical attack doing decent additional damage
[/list]
[*]Added Icedrake's "Ult" move
[*]Added some visual effects for certain actions
[*]Fixed Element Proccing issues
[*]Fixed some other bugs
[*]Adjusted timings between attacks
[*]Updated Unreal engine to 5.5
[/list]

I'll explain some of the major stuff. "Team Attacks" happen when you select the same action for two to three of your characters. They will do the same action on the same turn; the turn of the faster/fastest character. This serves two initial purposes; one, to make 3 v 3 turns faster. Two, to rush down the enemy before they take their turn. There could be other things team attacks could serve but I don't know what they are yet, I just added it recently.

I've added the water element; which slows down non water units and speeds up all water characters. I've also added the Icedrakes "Ult" called Arsenal which increases her attack and defense by a lot and is repeatable. 

I have updated the game engine so I don't know if some of the code needs updating too. One of UE 5.5's feature additions is an update to how Lighting and Shadows work. That said you cannot see these changes because it requires Lumen which requires Ray Tracing to be turned on. I've kept ray tracing off for this game because it hits your graphics card by a bit and you can't see any changes if you don't have the proper hardware. For Unreal Engine; you cannot toggle Ray-tracing in-game because it affects the shaders meaning you would have to recompile shaders every time you flip the switch and UE doesn't let you do that.

That all said, If some of you guys have a good system that can run raytracing well, I might redesign the levels in the game to take advantage of the pretty lights and stuff, then compile TWO versions of the game; one with raytracing and one without and you'd be able to select which one you want to play on game launch. That's if anyone's interested, if not I'll continue as is.

Lastly, I'll be working on the next character, and after I'll be adding some more additional mechanics. Then when I release this update, I'll also show the roadmap of updates till version 1.0. so...

-regalfang

notes.title: Demon's Regalia: Colosseum is a game.
notes.content:
Welcome. This is Demon's Regalia: Colosseum, a turn-based fighting RPG. The main feature of this game is Monster Girls, and more importantly, being made in 3D. Now, the game that inspired me to make this one is probably the first game I remember ever even playing; Pokémon Stadium. I wanted that, but [b]monster girls[/b] so here we are. I started making DR:C right after I released my previous game; Keep of the Witch. In current, the game is lacking a lot of features; it is still in development and I can't promise any specific feature, but I can say what I have added starting form the beginning. I'll just be showing the versions of the game and their points, it's much faster than explaining every mechanic I added and changed in detail.

Currently it ends with 0.1.3 and an alternate version of it I will release as the demo here on steam. I will say; the one thing that the game is gravely missing is its [u]music[/u]. The only thing I paid for was the registration of the game here on steam, other than using sound FX packs I already got making my previous game, and using UE5, I have made everything my self.
